vulnerabilities.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL Command in FortiMail webmail

notes.title: Summary
notes.text: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL Command in FortiMail webmail

notes.title: Additional info
notes.text: Fortinet in Q1/26 has remediated this issue in FortiMail Cloud and hence the customers need not perform any action.

remediations.details:
FortiMail 8.0: Not Applicable
FortiMail 7.6: Upgrade to 7.6.4 or above
FortiMail 7.4: Upgrade to 7.4.6 or above
FortiMail 7.2: Upgrade to 7.2.9 or above
